creator: Moosy Research
title: Community Firmware PR36 RGB Example
notes:
Go60 Per-Key & Per-Layer RGB – Requires PR36 Community Firmware
⚠️ This feature is not recommended for beginners, as it requires community firmware (not the official MoErgo firmware) and additional configuration beyond the standard Go60 setup.

Why? 
Per-key/layer RGB support isn’t yet available in the underlying ZMK keyboard firmware. MoErgo follows a policy of avoiding deviations from standard ZMK unless absolutely necessary. The PR36 community firmware, adds this functionality. 

A huge thank-you to @darknao https://github.com/darknao for developing and maintaining this firmware, and to @moosy for providing templates and beginner-friendly documentation.

🌈 Getting Started
───────────────────
• In the Layout Editor, select community.pr36.per-key-rgb under Settings.
• In Advanced Configuration, enable EXPERIMENTAL_RGB_LAYER.
• Build the firmware and flash it to both halves of your Go60.
• Perform a Configuration Factory Reset on both halves.
• Turn on RGB underglow using RGB_TOG (Magic + T).
• Cycle through RGB effects with RGB_EFF (Magic + G) until the home-row lights up.
The layer effect is located after the swirl effect and before the static color effect.
More: https://sites.google.com/view/tailorkey/how-to/rgb

🎨 Defining RGB Scheme
──────────────────────
RGB layers are defined in the Custom Device-tree between the lines:

==== PER-KEY-RGB <section begins> ====
...
==== PER-KEY-RGB <section ends> =====

• Use the empty layer template in the comment to add a new layer
• The bindings parameter visually represents the LED layout
• ___ means the LED is OFF
• Colors: predefined names from zmk rgb_colors.h or any RGB hex code (e.g., 0x40E0D0 for turquoise)
• layer-id must match the keymap layer identifier (e.g., LAYER_Base, LAYER_Lower)
• RGB layer name must be unique, ideally matching the keymap layer

🎛 RGB Features
──────────────
HID Indicator Colors:
• &ug_nl COLOR_OFF COLOR_ON → NumLock
• &ug_cl COLOR_OFF COLOR_ON → CapsLock
• &ug_sl COLOR_OFF COLOR_ON → ScrollLock
• COLOR_OFF = indicator off
• COLOR_ON = indicator on

Battery Level Indicators:
• &ug_b2 BELOW ABOVE → <20%
• &ug_b4 BELOW ABOVE → <40%
• &ug_b6 BELOW ABOVE → <60%
• &ug_b8 BELOW ABOVE → <80%
• BELOW shows when battery is below threshold
• ABOVE shows when battery is above threshold

Fade-out Feature:
• fade-delay makes RGB layers fade out after a number of seconds
• -1 = layer stays on continuously
• Fade speed adjustable with RGB_SPI and RGB_SPD keys on Magic layer

💡 Extra Notes
───────────────
• Active RGB layer always matches the highest active keymap layer
• If a keymap layer does not have a defined RGB layer, all LEDs turn off
• RGB underglow uses battery; avoid permanent base-layer RGB for longer battery life
• Below 20% battery → RGB automatically turns off

🔄 Returning to Standard Firmware
──────────────────────────────────
• Create a regular firmware file in the Layout Editor
• Flash both halves
• Perform a Configuration Factory Reset

/*
 * ===================================================================
 * PR36 Community Firmware: ZMK Per-Key/Layer RGB and Underglow Layers
 * ===================================================================
 *
 * This defines RGB colors for per-key and per-layer lighting on the Base and Keypad layers.
 *
 */

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * PR36 EMPTY UNDERGLOW LAYER TEMPLATE
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 *
 *     mylayer {
 *         bindings = <
 *           ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
 *           ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
 *           ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
 *           ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
 *                   ___ ___ ___                                             ___ ___ ___ 
 *                                        ___ ___ ___     ___ ___ ___ 
 *         >;
 *         layer-id = <LAYER_Name>;
 *     };
 */

/* ============================================================
 * COLOR PALETTE (PER-KEY RGB)
 * ============================================================
 *
 * All colors use &ug (underglow set) with 24-bit RGB.
 * Naming is intentionally short for layout readability.
 */

#if __has_include(<dt-bindings/zmk/rgb_colors.h>)
  //
  // Color definitions with conflict guard to prevent
  // accidental redefinition of common abbreviations.
  //
  #if defined(RED) || defined(RED_RGB) || \
      defined(COR) || defined(COR_RGB) || \
      defined(ORN) || defined(ORN_RGB) || \
      defined(GDN) || defined(GDN_RGB) || \
      defined(GOL) || defined(GOL_RGB) || \
      defined(YLW) || defined(YLW_RGB) || \
      defined(CHU) || defined(CHU_RGB) || \
      defined(GRN) || defined(GRN_RGB) || \
      defined(SPG) || defined(SPG_RGB) || \
      defined(CYN) || defined(CYN_RGB) || \
      defined(AZU) || defined(AZU_RGB) || \
      defined(TEA) || defined(TEA_RGB) || \
      defined(TUR) || defined(TUR_RGB) || \
      defined(BLU) || defined(BLU_RGB) || \
      defined(PUR) || defined(PUR_RGB) || \
      defined(MAJ) || defined(MAJ_RGB) || \
      defined(PNK) || defined(PNK_RGB) || \
      defined(WHT) || defined(WHT_RGB) || \
      defined(BLK) || defined(BLK_RGB) || \
      defined(___) || \
      defined(DUG) || defined(DUG_RGB) || \
      defined(LAC) || defined(LAC_RGB) || \
      defined(BSL) || defined(BNL) || defined(BCL) || \
      defined(SSL) || defined(SNL) || defined(SCL) || \
      defined(FST) || defined(WRP) || defined(SLO)
  #error "Naming conflict: 3-letter color abbreviation already defined!"
  #endif

  //
  // Color definitions
  //
  #define RED_RGB 0xFF0000
  #define COR_RGB 0xFF7C4D
  #define ORN_RGB 0xFF8000
  #define GDN_RGB 0xD9A521
  #define GOL_RGB 0xFFD900
  #define YLW_RGB 0xFFFF00
  #define CHU_RGB 0x80FF00
  #define GRN_RGB 0x00FF00
  #define SPG_RGB 0x00FF80
  #define CYN_RGB 0x00FFFF
  #define AZU_RGB 0x99F5FF
  #define TEA_RGB 0x008080
  #define TUR_RGB 0x476E6A
  #define BLU_RGB 0x0000FF
  #define PUR_RGB 0x7A00FF
  #define MAJ_RGB 0xFF00FF
  #define PNK_RGB 0xFF80BF
  #define WHT_RGB 0xFFFFFF
  #define BLK_RGB 0x000000
  #define DUG_RGB 0x00FF68
  #define LAC_RGB 0x6B1FCE

  //
  // Short color names
  //
  #define RED &ug RED_RGB
  #define COR &ug COR_RGB
  #define ORN &ug ORN_RGB
  #define GDN &ug GDN_RGB
  #define GOL &ug GOL_RGB
  #define YLW &ug YLW_RGB
  #define CHU &ug CHU_RGB
  #define GRN &ug GRN_RGB
  #define SPG &ug SPG_RGB
  #define CYN &ug CYN_RGB
  #define AZU &ug AZU_RGB
  #define TEA &ug TEA_RGB
  #define TUR &ug TUR_RGB
  #define BLU &ug BLU_RGB
  #define PUR &ug PUR_RGB
  #define MAJ &ug MAJ_RGB
  #define PNK &ug PNK_RGB
  #define WHT &ug WHT_RGB
  #define ___ &ug BLK_RGB
  #define DUG &ug DUG_RGB
  #define LAC &ug LAC_RGB

  //
  // Lock-key underglow for Base layer
  //
  #define BSL &ug_sl BLK_RGB RED_RGB
  #define BNL &ug_nl BLK_RGB RED_RGB
  #define BCL &ug_cl BLK_RGB RED_RGB

  //
  // Mouse speed indicators
  //
  #define FST GOL
  #define WRP CHU
  #define SLO COR

  // ==== PER-KEY RGB LAYERS BEGIN ====
  / {
    underglow-layer {
      compatible = "zmk,underglow-layer";

      #ifdef LAYER_Base
      Base {
        bindings = <
          ___ ___ BCL BNL BSL ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
          ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
          ___ MAJ CYN CHU YLW ___                                     ___ YLW CHU CYN MAJ ___
          ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___                                     ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
                  ___ ___ ___                                             ___ ___ ___ 
                                       ___ ___ ___     ___ ___ ___ 
        >;
        layer-id = <LAYER_Base>;
        fade-delay = <30>;
      };
      #endif

      #ifdef LAYER_Keypad
      Keypad {
        bindings = <
          ___ WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT                                     WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT 
          WHT ___ GRN GRN GRN GRN                                     WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT 
          WHT YLW GRN GRN GRN GRN                                     WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT ORN
          ___ YLW YLW YLW YLW YLW                                     WHT WHT WHT WHT WHT ___
                  ___ WHT WHT                                             WHT WHT WHT 
                                       WHT WHT WHT     WHT WHT WHT 
        >;
        layer-id = <LAYER_Keypad>;
        fade-delay = <15>;
      };
      #endif

    }; // end underglow-layer
  };   // end /

  /* ============================================================
   * BEHAVIORS
   * ============================================================
   */
  / {
    behaviors {

      /*
       * uglowbat
       * ----------
       * Battery-aware underglow behavior.
       */
      uglowbat: uglowbat {
        compatible = "zmk,behavior-underglow-battery";
        threshold = <30>;
        #binding-cells = <2>;
      };
    }; // end behaviors
  };   // end /

  // ==== PER-KEY RGB LAYERS END ====

  // Cleanup
  #undef RED
  #undef RED_RGB
  #undef COR
  #undef COR_RGB
  #undef ORN
  #undef ORN_RGB
  #undef GDN
  #undef GDN_RGB
  #undef GOL
  #undef GOL_RGB
  #undef YLW
  #undef YLW_RGB
  #undef CHU
  #undef CHU_RGB
  #undef GRN
  #undef GRN_RGB
  #undef SPG
  #undef SPG_RGB
  #undef CYN
  #undef CYN_RGB
  #undef AZU
  #undef AZU_RGB
  #undef TEA
  #undef TEA_RGB
  #undef TUR
  #undef TUR_RGB
  #undef BLU
  #undef BLU_RGB
  #undef PUR
  #undef PUR_RGB
  #undef MAJ
  #undef MAJ_RGB
  #undef PNK
  #undef PNK_RGB
  #undef WHT
  #undef WHT_RGB
  #undef BLK
  #undef BLK_RGB
  #undef ___
  #undef DUG
  #undef DUG_RGB
  #undef LAC
  #undef LAC_RGB

  #undef BSL
  #undef BNL
  #undef BCL

  #undef SSL
  #undef SNL
  #undef SCL

  #undef FST
  #undef WRP
  #undef SLO
#endif
